verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs' speech-to-text page says users can select up to 1000 specific words or sentences for Scribe to transcribe accurately based on context. That is a first-party keyword-boosting capability that covers domain terms, names and jargon. However, the pack documents no API parameter for it, so developer access is only implied. There is also no evidence of measured accuracy impact and no independent or hands-on corroboration, so it falls short of complete story coverage. Missing for 10: API-reference documentation of the keyterm/custom-vocabulary parameter for batch and realtime endpoints, evidence of boosting weights or limits per request, independent hands-on confirmation that boosted terms transcribe correctly.

support.subject: As a developer, I can boost domain terms, names, and jargon through custom vocabulary or keyword boosting so they transcribe correctly
